why: replace the scaffold placeholders in refined-building's overview and the domains and standards indexes with its real content

ops.body: Refined Building is an Oxygen Not Included mod that lets every refined metal be used wherever a building asks for raw Metal Ore: wire, pneumatic doors and airlocks, mesh tiles, batteries, pumps, valves, vents, coal generators, the electrolyzer, sinks and showers. After the game loads its element table, every solid element tagged `RefinedMetal` that lacks the `Metal` tag gets it, so the refined metals appear in those buildings' material lists. It finds the metals at runtime, so it covers the base game, the enabled DLCs and refined metals added by other mods. Buildings that ask for Refined Metal are untouched. It does the same job as Cairath's Refined Metals Usable As Raw Metals, without a fixed list. Version 1.0.1 is built; `publish/retired.txt` records that the mod is unlisted on the Workshop (id 3806989781) because an existing mod already does this job. `mod.yaml` sets `supportedContent: ALL` and `minimumSupportedBuild: 744825`.

- `src/RefinedBuilding/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` (entry point), `Patches.cs` (the postfix on `ElementLoader.Load` that tags the metals), `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`.
- `src/RefinedBuilding.Tests/`: in-game tests (`RefinedMetals.cs`).
- `publish/`: Workshop material (`workshop-description.txt`, `workshop-id.txt`, `retired.txt`).
- `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: user-facing description and release history.
- `.context/` holds `overview.md` (this file), `domains/` (entities and glossary), `standards/` (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/`, `retrospectives/`, `projects.md` and `META.md`.

- [entities](entities.md): what the mod patches (the element table load that tags refined metals), with file locations, the tagging rules and key code paths.
- [glossary](glossary.md): ONI and mod-specific terms used by Refined Building.

- [code-style](code-style.md): C# formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and component conventions, with this mod's own layout.
- [error-handling](error-handling.md): how Refined Building guards its Harmony patches, reflection lookups and file reads, and what it logs when something is missing.
- [naming-conventions](naming-conventions.md): file, namespace, patch class, string key and id naming for project RefinedBuilding.
